formats: text frames carry the exact UTF-8 text; binary frames carry whole-frame hex (base64 when > 512 bytes), decoded alongside

attach_control.summary: the "control" attach frame (the first text frame)
attach_control.outcome: answered by the attach ack; a resent frame is re-acknowledged

attach_scope.summary: the "scope" attach frame (the first text frame)
attach_scope.outcome: answered by the attach ack; a resent frame is re-acknowledged

attach_audio.summary: the "audio" attach frame (the first text frame)
attach_audio.outcome: answered by the attach ack; a resent frame is re-acknowledged

attach_api.summary: the "api" attach frame (the first text frame)
attach_api.outcome: silent until the first request (the keyless acquire path)

attach_ack_scope.summary: the scope attach ack (the first server text frame)
attach_ack_scope.outcome: the client stops resending its attach

attach_ack_audio.summary: the audio attach ack (the first server text frame)
attach_ack_audio.outcome: the client stops resending its attach

api_tx_refused.summary: a request with a body and its 403, id 1
api_tx_refused.outcome: a TX-capable body is refused before the shared dispatch

api_not_found.summary: a request for an unknown path and its 404, id 2

api_ok.summary: a plain GET and its normal 200 response, id 3

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' ws: wss:; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; media-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net

api_ok.outcome: RES_HEAD, one RES_BODY per <= 16 KB of body, then END

api_chunked.summary: a chunked multi-message body (> 16 KB), id 4

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' ws: wss:; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; media-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net

api_cancel.summary: CANCEL drops request 41 before it answers
api_cancel.outcome: no frame is ever sent for id 41; the channel keeps serving

api_unknown_id_ignored.summary: frames for an unknown id are a no-op, id 9999
api_unknown_id_ignored.outcome: no ERROR, no answer; the channel keeps serving

api_errors.summary: every terminal ERROR frame, with its trigger

triggers.stale_id: resend the api_not_found head with id 5: the resend answers stale_id (a rejected head never consumes its id)
triggers.timeout: reassembly or dispatch outlasting request_deadline_s answers timeout
triggers.too_large: REQ_HEAD id 7 then 16384-byte REQ_BODYs of 'x': past max_request_body_bytes
triggers.busy: 33 REQ_HEADs with no END: ids 8..39 fill the 32 slots; the 33rd answers busy
triggers.malformed: any frame shorter than the 7-byte header (the bytes 01 02 00 00)
